rationale: The negative half of the include channel. A first version accepted any tag whose name BEGAN `include` or `import`, and this fixture caught it: `!included_decoration` and `!include_real` were both read as file references. YAML tags are an open vocabulary, so a prefix rule over them is a substring rule wearing a costume. The include set is now a closed list of the tags the defining ecosystems actually use, and the cost of that precision -- an include-family tag outside the list is not recognised -- is declared in the spec rather than hidden.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
